ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) focal clusters; estimated ratio of 9:1 dark-to-light pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark lobes punctuated by approximately 45 high-contrast white annular and circular blobs (rosettes); highest spatial density occurs on the distal third of the left lobe and along the superior margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth ratio of ~0.18 relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; distal tips exhibit heavy, bulbous irregular protrusions isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the leading edges, with a broadly splayed scalloped trajectory along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of numerous circular white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameters) across both lobes; distinct grouping of approximately 12 rosettes in the center-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin high-intensity linear streaks detected in the lower-central region of the left lobe, oriented horizontally and cutting across natural pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white annular scarring (barnacle attachment marks) across both lobes; significant jagged white protrusions and pigment loss at the distal tips indicative of high-energy contact or long-term colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'figure-eight' fused rosette scar pattern located in the mid-upper section of the left lobe.
